meaning: to chat; to talk casually with friends

example.hakka: 𠊎兜昨日暗晡摎朋友聊天。
example.romanization: ngài-teu cho̍k-ngit am-bû lâu pèn-yû liâu-thiên.
example.english: Yesterday evening we chatted with friends.

note: 聊天 is used for relaxed, friendly conversation, often over tea or while sitting outside the house. Hakka also has the more colloquial 講giang/講故事, but 聊天 is widely understood.
